adapterMatrix.note: Adapter compatibility cells. Cells are generated from this section plus `probes`, `reactEpochs` and `pixiEpochs`; nothing lists a cell by hand. A cell names its adapters as data (artifact, entry, class), so a package-layout change edits rows here only. Exact React and Pixi versions come from the audited `probes` tuples.

multi-root.default-text-style-global.reason: On React 19.0 and 19.1 the Text that existed before a second Application set defaultTextStyle reports the new fontSize (41) instead of the baseline: the style change is not non-retroactive. React 18.3, 19.2 and 19.3 pass the same scenario, on Pixi 8.2.6 and 8.22.0 alike. First observed by the issue-13 cells; the fake-Pixi fixtures never exercised it.
multi-root.default-text-style-global.owner: React 19 epoch owner (issue 9); follow-up issue not yet filed

pr.description: Required check: each React epoch at its latest patch against the minimum and the current Pixi 8, plus fast probes at every named Pixi 8 boundary.

nightly.description: Full cross-product: every React epoch at its latest patch against every Pixi 8 minor at its latest audited patch, plus every audited probe tuple.

negative.description: The React 19.3 adapter installed beside React 19.1.9. The peer list accepts the version, so only the adapter environment check can reject it.
The React 18 adapter installed beside React 19.3.0: the strict peer check must refuse the install.
The Pixi 8 adapter beside the excluded pixi.js 8.5.0: the strict peer check refuses the install.
The same pair installed with --legacy-peer-deps (a consumer that ignores peers): the adapter's own environment check must still reject pixi.js 8.5.0.
